summary.text: Customers find the rangoli powder useful for festivals, though the quality and color selection receive mixed reviews - while some find it good, others report issues with colors not coming out of the bottles. Moreover, the bottles are very small, the powder is coarse, and customers report poor functionality with nozzles not working properly. Additionally, customers disagree on whether the product is worth the price.
